protocol.target: Reported average burning-rate constant K in mm2/s, only source-matched positive-rate non-disrupted trials. Not extinction probability.
protocol.excluded_features: No outcome, burn duration, extinction diameter, source ID, date or test number as predictor. N2 omitted as near-redundant gas-balance component.
protocol.splits: sklearn GroupKFold(n_splits=5,shuffle=False). Primary groups fuel + rounded0.1atm pressure bin + exact nominal composition, all sizes together. Secondary entire campaign date held out. No row random split.
protocol.weights: Equal group weights, normalized to row mean1, using training groups only; scores equal-group MAE, per-fuel and gas-presence diagnostics.
protocol.ridge: alpha1, training-only weighted standardization; log target, exponentiate, no smearing or clipping; float64 CUDA solve
protocol.gate: Primary log_ridge must improve primary overall equal-group MAE by >=10% versus stronger of fuel median/same-fuel nearest AND neither fuel MAE worsens >10% versus its stronger simple baseline. CatBoost exploratory comparator. Secondary date split reported regardless, not selected to rescue primary failure. No practical safety tolerance or causal claim.
protocol.source_qualification: 198 candidates from274 CSV rows/258 numeric rates after all9 numeric fields match original Appendix A;76 review rows retained. No pressure0 repair or mixture renormalization. Unknown support-fiber/translation/velocity metadata are material limitations.
protocol.deployment: Show held-out prediction comparisons at recorded conditions only, no new-input prediction, no CO2/He causal effectiveness or extinction-control claims. No synthetic droplet trajectory labels.
protocol.verification: Freeze input hashes, splits and script; CUDA Blackwell required, saved CatBoost models reloaded, independent CPU ridge/baselines and source reconciliation, all metrics/hashes verified; no overwrite

summary.target: Reported average slope magnitude of diameter squared versus time, mm²/s, Table IX. No extinction classifier.
limitations: Conditional on recorded positive rates and non-disrupted trials; not all attempted burns.
Initial nominal O2/N2/CO2/He composition; no normalization or assumed gas correction.
Support-fiber, translation and residual-motion metadata not encoded in this summary; confounding remains.
Pressure bin0.1atm defines validation groups only; original mmHg retained as feature.
Visible extinction is not a verified cessation of all combustion.
No causal suppressant ranking, discharge dynamics or spacecraft extinguisher design.
